finalText:
Migration done. 12 files converted, all `db.query(sql, params)` calls now `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`
- `packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support/src/repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

All pass `node --check`.

Two left untouched, on purpose:

- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13` — vendored legacy-orm 2.1.4, header says "Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local changes are silently lost." Real dependency on deprecated `db.query`, needs upstream fix or a wrapper. Your call.
- `cache.query(...)` calls across repos — different object (`lib/cache.js`), not part of this migration.
